notes.title: Hexalert 1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068053/4fac320e0d2ed06fbb08a375dff31dfc40d60dc8.png
Hexalert patch 1.2 contains:
Fixes for various bugs.
Updated keybinds allowing for quickly changing your units weapon with "Q" or utility with "E".
Updated pause menu.
Added ingame music player with two new songs.

Also with this patch Hexalert contains support for Linux!
